features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1652: Therapeutic hip abduction orthosis for gentle stretching and contracture management.
ADJUSTABLE ABDUCTION BAR: Customizable 30-45° positioning for targeted hip adductor lengthening.
PROGRESSIVE EXTENSION THERAPY: Promotes tissue elongation and joint mobility in post-op and contracture care.
COMFORTABLE THIGH CUFFS: Soft, contoured cuffs ensure even support and prevent slippage.
DUAL-USE FUNCTIONALITY: Suitable for use in-bed or in a wheelchair for rehabilitation versatility.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
